instruction: Browse the FlightAware community to see the top-rated discussions.

metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating to FlightAware discussions and viewing the top-rated topics page. Similar interaction pattern to the original task (navigate discussions, apply filter/sort criterion, view results). Uses existing Chrome evaluator functions (get_active_tab_info and is_expected_active_tab) to verify the top topics page is opened.
metadata.similarity_justification: Same website (FlightAware discussions), same interaction pattern (navigate discussions, apply sorting/filtering by rating/popularity), same difficulty level. Only difference is viewing top-rated topics instead of finding a specific topic by reply count.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly uses get_active_tab_info to extract the active tab URL
Metric is_expected_active_tab properly compares the extracted URL with the expected URL using compare_urls utility
Expected URL https://discussions.flightaware.com/top correctly matches the instruction requirement to view top-rated discussion topics
Data flow is correct: getter returns dict with url/title/content, metric extracts url and compares
Complete coverage: evaluator fully verifies that user navigated to the top-rated discussions page
Evaluator logic will work correctly at runtime
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor note: get_active_tab_info reloads the target URL which could potentially affect pages with redirects or dynamic behavior, but for URL verification tasks this should not cause issues
